examples.en: We learn about Australia in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上了解澳大利亚。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Australia 澳大利亚有袋鼠和考拉。

examples.en: The cat is behind the door.
The school is behind the park.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The cat is behind the door. behind 是在……后面。

examples.en: The cat is beside the chair.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：beside 音近「比赛的」，比赛的选手 beside 在旁边。
语义联想：把「在……的旁边」和英文 beside 配对记忆。

examples.en: Her hair is long and black.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hair 音近「海尔」，海尔的 hair 头发。
语义联想：She has long hair. hair 是头发。

examples.en: Wait a minute. It will not take long.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She has long hair. long 是长的。

examples.en: Every pupil is in the classroom.
examples.zh: 每个小学生都在教室里。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：pupil 音近「皮优尔」，皮优尔是 pupil 小学生。
语义联想：把「小学生」和英文 pupil 配对记忆。
语义联想：He is short. short 是短的、矮的。

examples.en: My brother is tall and strong.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：tall 音近「套」，套着 tall 高个子的衣服。
语义联想：The boy is tall. tall 是高的。

examples.en: We give a flower to our teacher.
The flower is on the paper.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：flower 音近「弗劳尔」，弗劳尔送 flower 花。
形象联想：想象 Teachers' Day 送 flower 花给老师。

examples.en: She is kind to every pupil.
examples.zh: 她对每个小学生都很和蔼。

examples.en: Thank you for your kind help.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our teacher is kind. kind 是亲切的、和蔼的。
语义联想：The panda is lovely. lovely 是可爱的。

examples.en: The school is near my home.
Is there a cinema near here?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：near 音近「尼尔」，尼尔住 near 附近。
语义联想：把「在附近」和英文 near 配对记忆。

examples.en: The panda is near the tree.
I like the panda very much.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：panda 音近「潘达」，潘达就是 panda 熊猫。
形象联想：想象 lovely panda 可爱的熊猫。

examples.en: Draw a picture on the paper.
The card is made of paper.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：paper 音近「佩珀」，佩珀拿 paper 纸。
语义联想：把「纸」和英文 paper 配对记忆。

examples.en: This is a photo of my class.
Take a photo of the panda.
I put the photo in my book.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：photo 音近「佛头」，佛头拍 photo 照片。
形象联想：想象 take a photo of the panda 给熊猫拍照。

examples.en: This is a picture of a panda.
Draw a picture for Teachers' Day.
Look at the picture on the wall.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 picture 图画挂在 sitting room 客厅。
语义联想：Teachers' Day is in September. September 是九月。

examples.en: We watch TV in the sitting room.
Come to the sitting room, please.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sitting 坐 + room 房间，sitting room 是客厅。

examples.en: The teacher can smile at us.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She has a lovely smile. smile 是微笑。

examples.en: We give flowers on Teachers' Day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：teacher 老师 + day 日，Teachers' Day 是教师节。

谐音联想：tomorrow 音近「特毛柔」，特毛柔说明天 tomorrow。
语义联想：把「明天」和英文 tomorrow 配对记忆。

谐音联想：where 音近「威尔」，威尔问 where 哪里。
语义联想：把「哪里」和英文 where 配对记忆。

examples.zh: 告诉我关于国庆节的事。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Tell me about National Day. about 是关于。

examples.en: It is very hot in August.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：August is hot. August 是八月。

examples.en: Find your book on page ten.
Let us find the way to the museum.
examples.zh: 让我们找到去博物馆的路。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Find your book. find 是找到、发现。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 finds；过去式 found

examples.en: We have a long holiday in October.
examples.zh: 十月我们有一个长假期。

examples.en: I will tell you about my holiday.
examples.zh: 我会告诉你我的假期情况。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：holi 神圣 + day 日，holiday 是假日。

examples.en: I find pictures on the Internet.
Turn on the computer to use the Internet.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：inter 之间 + net 网，internet 是因特网。

examples.en: We visit my uncle in July.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We visit my uncle in July. July 是七月。

examples.en: There is a mount near the city.
We can see the mount from here.
examples.zh: 我们从这里能看到那座山。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 mount 山在 far away 远方。

examples.en: We have a holiday on National Day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：national 国家的 + day 日，National Day 是国庆节。

examples.zh: 十月是一个凉爽的月份。

examples.en: We have a holiday in October.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：National Day is in October. October 是十月。

examples.en: Let me tell you a story.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：tell 音近「泰尔」，泰尔 tell 告诉你。
语义联想：把「告诉」和英文 tell 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 tells；过去式 told

examples.en: There is a mount over there.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：There is a mount over there. there 是那里。

examples.en: Put your thing in the bag.
I find an interesting thing on the Internet.
examples.zh: 我在网上发现很多有趣的东西。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Put your things in the bag. thing 是东西。

examples.en: Don't turn on the computer now.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：turn 转 + on 开，turn on 是打开。

examples.en: I visit my uncle in July.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My uncle lives in Australia. uncle 是叔叔、伯伯。
拆词联想：will 将 + not 不，won't 就是「将不」。

examples.en: I am afraid of the dark.
The film is not scary. Don't be afraid.
examples.zh: 这部电影不吓人，别害怕。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象看 scary film 时 afraid 害怕。

examples.zh: 国际象棋是一种有趣的游戏。
我爸爸下国际象棋下得好。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象黑白棋子在 chess 棋盘上。

examples.en: Let us go to the cinema.
The cinema is near the museum.
We watch a film at the cinema.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cinema 音近「西呢嘛」，西呢嘛去 cinema 看电影。
形象联想：想象 go to the cinema 看电影。

examples.en: Come on! Let us go to the cinema.
Come on! Play chess with me.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Come on! Let us go. come on 是来吧。
语义联想：My mother can cook. cook 是烹调。

examples.en: We watch a film at the cinema.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We watch a film at the cinema. film 是电影。

examples.en: My glasses are on the desk.
I can't see without my glasses.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 put on glasses 戴眼镜看电影。

examples.en: The museum is near the cinema.
We see many old things in the museum.
examples.zh: 我们在博物馆里看到很多古老的东西。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：museum 音近「缪兹恩」，缪兹恩参观 museum 博物馆。
形象联想：想象 museum 博物馆里有很多 old things。

examples.en: My uncle likes to play chess.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜欢下国际象棋。

examples.en: Come on! Play chess with me.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：play 下 + chess 象棋，play chess 是下国际象棋。

examples.en: The player is young and strong.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He is a good player. player 是球员。

examples.en: Put on your coat. It is cold.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：put 放 + on 上，put on 是戴上、穿上。

examples.en: Sit down and watch the film.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sit 坐 + down 下，sit down 是坐下。
语义联想：Welcome to our school! welcome 是欢迎。
语义联想：April is a spring month. April 是四月。
语义联想：December is cold. December 是十二月。

examples.en: It is easy to remember the months.
English is not easy, but I like it.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This game is easy. easy 是容易的。

examples.en: Spring Festival is often in February.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：February is short. February 是二月。
语义联想：January is the first month. January 是一月。
语义联想：June is a summer month. June 是六月。
语义联想：March comes before April. March 是三月。

examples.zh: 五月是一个可爱的月份。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：May is warm. May 是五月。

examples.zh: 十月是我最喜欢的月份。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Which month is it? month 是月份。
语义联想：November is cool. November 是十一月。
语义联想：March or April? or 是或者。
语义联想：Remember the months. remember 是记住。

examples.en: Turn right at the bus stop.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：bus 公共汽车 + stop 停，bus stop 是公交车站。

examples.en: Excuse me. Where is the station?
Excuse me. Is there a hospital nearby?
Excuse me. How can I get to the museum?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Excuse me. Where is the station? Excuse me. 是请问、劳驾。
拆词联想：far 远 + away 离开，far away 是很远。

examples.en: How can I get to the station?
We get to the hospital by taxi.
examples.zh: 我们乘出租车到达医院。

examples.en: It is easy to get to the city.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：get 到达 + to 到，get to 是到达。

examples.zh: 一直往前走，然后向右转。

examples.en: Go straight. The hospital is on your left.
examples.zh: 一直往前走，医院在你左边。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 走 + straight 直，go straight 是一直往前走。

examples.en: Go straight. The hospital is on the right.
examples.zh: 一直往前走，医院在右边。

examples.en: Is there a hospital near here?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hospital 音近「好斯皮头」，好斯皮头去医院 hospital。
形象联想：想象 hospital 医院红十字标志。

examples.en: The bus stop is on the left.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Turn left, please. left 是左边的。

examples.zh: 一位亲切的男人帮助我。

examples.en: The man waits at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 这个男人在公交车站等候。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The young man is tall. man 是男人。

examples.en: There is a bus stop nearby.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The hospital is nearby. nearby 是附近。

examples.en: The hospital is on the right.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Turn right at the corner. right 是右边的。

examples.en: The bus stop is near the station.
Excuse me. Where is the station?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Where is the station? station 是车站。

examples.en: We get to the hospital by taxi.
examples.zh: 我们乘出租车到达医院。

examples.en: The taxi is near the station.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：taxi 音近「泰克西」，泰克西坐 taxi 的士。
形象联想：想象 take a taxi 到 station 车站。

examples.en: Turn right at the bus stop.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：turn 音近「特恩」，特恩 turn 转弯。
语义联想：把「转向」和英文 turn 配对记忆。

examples.en: You're welcome. I am happy to help.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：you're 你是 + welcome 欢迎，You're welcome. 是「不用谢」。

examples.en: The young man is a player.
examples.zh: 这个年轻男人是一名球员。

examples.en: The young pupil smiles at me.
examples.zh: 这名年轻的小学生对我微笑。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The young man is a player. young 是年轻的。

examples.en: Call me on my mobile, please.
I call my classmate every day.
examples.zh: 我每天都给同班同学打电话。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Call me on my mobile. call 是打电话。

examples.en: I live in a big city.
The museum is in the city.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I live in a big city. city 是城市。

谐音联想：minute 音近「米尼特」，米尼特等 minute 分钟。
语义联想：把「分钟」和英文 minute 配对记忆。
语义联想：This is my mobile. mobile 是手机。

examples.en: I am on my way to school.
Wait a minute. I am on my way.
Call me when you are on your way.
examples.zh: 你在路上时给我打电话。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：on 在 + my 我的 + way 路，on my way 是在我去……的路上。

examples.en: Open your book at page ten.
Write the word on page five.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Open your book at page ten. page 是页。

examples.en: I am sorry. Wait a minute.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sorry 音近「扫瑞」，扫瑞说 sorry 对不起。
语义联想：看到「对不起」的事物时，就想到 sorry。
语义联想：Can I speak to Lily? speak 是说话。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 speaks；过去式 spoke

examples.en: Wait a minute. It is time to go.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What time is it? time 是时间、次数。

examples.en: Please wait. I am on my way.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wait a minute, please. wait 是等候、等待。

examples.en: Tell me the way to the station.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Which way is the hospital? way 是路、方向。

examples.en: Write the new word five times.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Read this word, please. word 是词。

examples.en: Write the word on the page.
I write a card for Teachers' Day.
examples.zh: 我为教师节写一张卡片。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：write 音近「瑞特」，瑞特 write 写字。
语义联想：把「写字」和英文 write 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 writes；过去式 wrote

examples.en: My classmate is from the USA.
examples.zh: 我的同班同学来自美国。

examples.en: I call my classmate every day.
examples.zh: 我每天都给同班同学打电话。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：class 班 + mate 伙伴，classmate 是同班同学。

examples.en: I know the way to the city.

examples.zh: 我很了解我的同班同学。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I know the way. know 是知道。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 knows；过去式 knew

examples.en: I see the museum on the right.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I see. Thank you. see 是明白、看见。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 sees；过去式 saw

examples.en: My classmate is from the USA.
examples.zh: 我的同班同学来自美国。

examples.en: We learn about the USA in class.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：the 这个 + USA 美国，the USA 是美国。
语义联想：I understand you. understand 是理解、明白。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 understands；过去式 understood
